description: This file defines the NotesController class in an ASP.NET Core Web API project, responsible for handling CRUD operations for notes, including list, get, create, update, and delete functionalities, with user authentication and authorization.

classes.name: NotesController
classes.description: Controller class managing CRUD operations for notes, secured with authorization, and interacting with the INoteService.

methods.name: GetUserId
methods.description: Extracts the user's GUID from the JWT token claims.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes for the current authenticated user.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its GUID for the current user.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new note for the current user based on the provided request.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by GUID for the current user.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific note by GUID for the current user.
